stories.title: Premio Nobel de la Paz 2026 para 'Navi' Pillay por sus esfuerzos para promover la paz y el derecho internacional

en.title: 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to 'Navi' Pillay for efforts to promote peace and international law
en.summary: South African jurist Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize by the Swedish Academy for her work advancing peace and international law. Pillay has held leaders and states accountable and provided support to victims of violence and conflict throughout her career.

stories.title: El juez Pedraz descarta “de momento” imputar al PSOE en el caso de las cloacas

en.title: Judge Pedraz rules out charging PSOE "for now" in the sewers case
en.summary: A Spanish judge has decided against immediately imputating the PSOE party in an ongoing investigation, instead opting to conduct additional proceedings following testimony from another judge in the case.

stories.title: El juez Pedraz rechaza imputar al PSOE "en este momento" en el 'caso Cloacas'

en.title: Judge Pedraz rejects charging PSOE "at this moment" in the Sewers case
en.summary: A judge investigating the case has determined there is insufficient evidentiary basis to charge the PSOE party at present, despite acknowledging the alleged facts could appear potentially criminal in nature.

stories.title: El juez del caso cloacas descarta imputar por ahora al PSOE por financiación ilegal

en.title: Judge in sewers case rules out charging PSOE now for illegal financing
en.summary: A Spanish judge has declined to indict the PSOE party for various charges including bribery and illegal financing, determining that current evidence does not establish investigative grounds despite potential criminal appearance of the alleged conduct.

stories.title: La jurista sudafricana Navi Pillay, Premio Nobel de la Paz 2026

en.title: South African jurist Navi Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navi Pillay, a South African jurist, has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize by the Norwegian Nobel Committee for her work promoting peace, international law, and bringing hope to victims of violence and conflict.

stories.title: La jurista Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay, Premio Nobel de la Paz 2026

en.title: Jurist Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, a South African jurist of Indian descent, has been recognized with the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. She has served on multiple international tribunals throughout her career.

stories.title: Feijóo acepta un debate cara a cara con Sánchez y otro a cuatro con el resto de candidatos

en.title: Feijóo accepts one-on-one debate with Sánchez and four-way debate with other candidates
en.summary: Spanish political leader Feijóo has agreed to participate in a direct debate with Sánchez and a four-candidate debate. The Socialist Party says it will attend all debates but disputes the PP's authority to decide debate format and participants.

stories.title: La jurista sudafricana Navanethem Pillay gana el Nobel de Paz del 2026

en.title: South African jurist Navanethem Pillay wins 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: Navanethem Pillay, a South African jurist, has won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize. She previously presided over the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and served as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.

stories.title: El juez Pedraz rechaza imputar “en este momento” al PSOE en el ‘caso Leire Díez’, como pedía el PP

en.title: Judge Pedraz rejects charging PSOE 'at this moment' in Leire Díez case, as PP requested
en.summary: A judge declined to indict the PSOE party in an ongoing corruption investigation, following arguments from prosecutors that while indicators existed, further proceedings were still needed.

stories.title: Feijóo acepta dos debates electorales con Sánchez, incluido un cara a cara, y a TVE le concede sólo una entrevista

en.title: Feijóo accepts two electoral debates with Sánchez, including a head-to-head, and grants TVE only one interview
en.summary: The PP leader agreed to two debates with the prime minister, proposing November 16 for the main confrontation, while limiting his appearance on public broadcaster TVE to a single interview.

stories.title: Feijóo propone un cara a cara con Sánchez el 16 de noviembre en Mediaset

en.title: Feijóo proposes a head-to-head with Sánchez on November 16 on Mediaset
en.summary: The PP leader offered a direct debate with the prime minister on November 16 via Mediaset, accepted additional debates with left-wing opponents, and set conditions for a public broadcaster interview.

stories.title: Un agente del ICE hiere de bala a un hombre que estaba en su coche con un niño de cinco años en Nueva York

en.title: An ICE agent shoots a man in his car with a five-year-old child in New York
en.summary: An immigration enforcement officer fired on a man in a vehicle containing a young child in New York City, prompting the city mayor to demand an end to such operations.

stories.title: De un taller a adaptar vehículos para personas con movilidad reducida

en.title: From a workshop to adapting vehicles for people with reduced mobility
en.summary: Rehatrans evolved from a mechanical workshop into a factory capable of adapting 1,100 vans annually. The family business controls half the Spanish market and plans expansion into Portugal.

stories.title: El Ibex respira con el petróleo y con la deuda

en.title: The Ibex recovers with oil and debt
en.summary: Stock markets received positive signals as Trump's decision against military action on Iran eased oil prices and debt interest rates. The Ibex index aims to recover the 19,000 points lost previously.

stories.title: Bruselas impulsa dos nuevos proyectos mineros críticos en Ciudad Real y Galicia

en.title: Brussels promotes two new critical mining projects in Ciudad Real and Galicia
en.summary: The European Commission announced strategic projects receiving administrative advantages and financing support. Two Spanish mining initiatives joined seven previously announced projects among 46 newly selected programs.

stories.title: EEUU ejecutará públicamente a un exsoldado con un pelotón de fusilamiento

en.title: USA will publicly execute former soldier by firing squad
en.summary: The U.S. military will livestream the execution of an extremist convicted for killing 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas in 2009.

stories.title: MyInvestor mejora hasta el 3% TAE la rentabilidad de su depósito a 6 meses

en.title: MyInvestor improves 6-month deposit returns up to 3% APY
en.summary: MyInvestor is offering 3% APY on 6-month deposits for customers with an automated portfolio of at least 150 euros, and 2.75% APY for other customers.
